# Headspace

> Headspace is a comprehensive mental health and wellness platform offering guided meditations, sleep resources, online therapy, AI-powered coaching, and mindfulness tools for stress relief and emotional well-being.

Headspace provides evidence-based mental health support through meditation, therapy, and coaching services. The platform features content for all ages including specialized programs for anxiety, stress management, sleep wellness, and family mindfulness, complemented by an AI companion called Ebb.

## Key Topics

- Guided Meditations
- Mental Health
- Stress Relief
- Sleep Wellness
- Anxiety Management
- Mindfulness
- Online Therapy
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- AI Companion (Ebb)
- Meditation App
- Sleep Music
- Stress Management
- Mindful Families
- Workplace Mindfulness
- Emotional Well-being

## Core Products & Services

- [Mental Wellness App: Meditation & Sleep - Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/app): Main product page for Headspace meditation and wellness app
- [Online Therapy & Counseling for Everyday Mental Health – Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/online-therapy): Headspace online therapy service with licensed therapists and insurance
- [Online Mental Health and Wellness Coaching - Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/coaching): Text-based mental health coaching with CBT and ACT techniques
- [Meet Ebb | AI Mental Health Companion - Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/ai-mental-health-companion): Ebb AI companion for mental health support and stress relief

## Mental Health & Wellness Hubs

- [Mental Health and Wellness Resources and App | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health): Mental health hub with articles, courses, and meditation resources
- [Guided Meditation App and Resources | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/meditation): Core meditation content hub with guided meditations and courses
- [Mindfulness App: Exercises, Activities, and Resources | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/mindfulness): Mindfulness exercises and resources for presence and engagement
- [Online Sleep Meditation Resources and Sleep App | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/sleep): Sleep meditation and wellness resources including sleepcasts and music

## Condition-Specific Programs

- [Reduce Anxiety with Headspace | CBT & Anxiety App for Stress Relief](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health/anxiety): Anxiety relief program with CBT courses and guided meditations
- [Stress & Anxiety - Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health/stress): Stress management resources with mindfulness and CBT techniques

## Meditation & Mindfulness Content

- [Beginning Meditation | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/93): Beginner meditation techniques and fundamental practice guide
- [Guided Meditations for Anxiety](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/107): In-the-moment anxiety relief meditations and techniques
- [Courses and Singles | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/58): Meditation courses and single guided sessions catalog
- [New and Popular | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/100): Featured and latest meditations from Headspace content library

## Sleep & Relaxation Resources

- [Relaxing Sleep Music](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/175): Calming sleep music tracks for rest and relaxation
- [White Noise and Sleep Sounds](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/176): White noise and sleep sounds for focus and relaxation

## Specialized Wellness Programs

- [Mindful Families](https://www.headspace.com/app/mindful-families): Mindful parenting and family wellness content for all ages
- [Becoming a Mindful Parent | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/167): Mindful parenting guide with emotional intelligence practices
- [Mindfulness at Work | Headspace](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/166): Workplace mindfulness and stress management techniques
